environment.note: Linux container, no GPU passthrough. Windows figures must be measured on the target machine; these are not.

boot.what: constructing the agent, opening the store and building subsystems

arithmetic.what: full brain.ask through routing, the mathematics agent and math.eval; providers disabled

semantics.what: deterministic interpretation only (spelling, language, references); model pass is skipped without a provider

memory.what: written to a temporary store in this run, then recalled 30 times

retrieval.what: knowledge search over 80 generated documents; lexical + hashed embeddings, not a model

graph.what: 200-node chain, bounded two-hop expansion with seed matching

executor.what: five read-only tool steps through the real DAG executor (persistence, transitions, batching)

limits: No model was called; latency here is the deterministic core, not inference.
Linux container without a GPU: VRAM figures must be measured on the target Windows machine.
Memory and retrieval numbers use hashed embeddings, not nomic-embed-text.
Boot time is a single construction, not a cold start of Windows services.
